subject: Charged twice this month
body: Hi, I noticed two charges of $49 on my card for September. I only have one Pro subscription. Can you refund the duplicate? Thanks.

subject: Dashboard shows 500 error
body: Since this morning the analytics dashboard returns a 500 error every time I open it. Console shows a failed call to /api/v2/metrics. Nothing changed on our side.

subject: Can't log in after enabling 2FA
body: I turned on two-factor auth yesterday and now the codes from my authenticator app are rejected. I'm locked out. Please help, I have a demo at 3pm.

subject: Pricing for 40 seats
body: We're evaluating your product for our platform team. Could you send a quote for 40 seats on the enterprise plan, ideally with SSO? Happy to jump on a call.

subject: THIRD TIME asking
body: This is the third time I'm writing about the export feature silently failing. Nobody responds. If this isn't fixed this week I'm cancelling and I want my money back for the last two months.
notes: Primary issue is technical; refund is a secondary demand. Purchase is outside the 30-day auto window.

subject: Invoice needs our VAT number
body: Could you re-issue last month's invoice with our VAT ID (GB123456789) on it? Finance won't process it otherwise. No rush.

subject: I want a refund
body: I bought the annual plan on Friday by mistake, I meant to pick monthly. Please refund the annual charge and put me on monthly instead.
notes: Amount exceeds the $250 auto-approve limit — should route to a billing agent even though the model is confident.

subject: Change email on account
body: I left my old company and need to move my account from j.doe@oldco.com to my personal address. What's the process?

subject: API rate limits
body: We're hitting 429s at around 200 req/s. Is that the documented limit for enterprise? Can it be raised, and is there a cost?
notes: Could be technical (limits) or sales (cost to raise). Annotators split 3–2 for technical.

subject: Not asking for money back, just want it fixed
body: To be clear I am NOT asking for a refund. I just want the sync bug fixed. It's been broken since the last release and it's really annoying.
notes: Negation trap for keyword systems — the word 'refund' appears but is negated.

subject: Downgrade question
body: If I downgrade from Pro to Free mid-cycle, do I get the unused portion back, or does it just stop renewing?
notes: Asks *about* refunds hypothetically without requesting one. Good test of 'refund requested' vs 'refund mentioned'.

subject: Team can't see shared projects
body: Two of my teammates were added yesterday but shared projects don't show up for them. They've logged out and back in. Permissions look right on my end.
notes: Could be account (permissions) or technical (bug). Labelled technical because the user already verified permissions.

subject: Unacceptable
body: Your outage yesterday cost us a client demo. This is unacceptable for a product we pay $2,400 a year for. I expect a credit and an explanation from someone senior.
notes: 'Credit' is a refund-like request. Amount and age both fail auto-approve; frustration forces escalation regardless.

subject: Student discount?
body: Hey! Do you offer any student pricing? I'm doing my masters and would love to use the Pro features for my thesis project.

subject: Delete my account and data
body: Please delete my account and all associated data under GDPR. Confirm when done.

subject: Webhook retries
body: Our endpoint was down for an hour and we missed some webhooks. Do you retry, and if so with what backoff? Can we replay the missed events?

subject: Refund for accidental add-on
body: My colleague added the Premium Support add-on ($199) without approval. We don't need it. Can that be reversed? Purchased about a week ago.
notes: Should auto-refund: eligible, under limit, in window, clear intent.

subject: Refund
body: refund pls
notes: Refund is requested, but the account is not refund-eligible (free tier, no order). Authorization must veto before any model opinion counts.

subject: Slow queries since upgrade
body: After upgrading to Pro the query builder feels slower, like 3–4 seconds per query where it used to be instant. Is Pro on different infrastructure?

subject: Love the product, one ask
body: Genuinely love what you've built. One thing: could you add dark mode to the mobile app? My eyes would thank you.
notes: Feature request — no 'feature request' department exists, so it lands in technical. Shows what happens when your label set doesn't cover reality.

subject: SSO setup for Okta
body: We're on the enterprise plan and want to configure SAML with Okta. Where do I find the ACS URL and entity ID?
notes: Account vs technical split. Labelled account because it is configuration, not a defect.

subject: Wrong card charged
body: You charged my personal card instead of the company card I added last week. Please refund the personal card and charge the company one. It's $49.

subject: Is the API down?
body: Getting timeouts on every call for the last 20 minutes. Status page says all green. Is something going on?

subject: Cancel and refund immediately
body: Cancel my subscription and refund me immediately. I signed up 2 days ago, the product does not do what your landing page says, and I don't want to argue about it.
notes: Refund path is clear and within limits, but frustration ≥ 3 should also trigger a human touch. Both gates fire; the pipeline must show both.

subject: Question about seats
body: We have 8 seats and 8 people. If one person leaves and another joins, do we need a 9th seat or can we reassign? Also what's the per-seat price these days?
notes: Seat mechanics (account) plus pricing (sales). Labelled sales by majority.

subject: Password reset email never arrives
body: I've requested a password reset four times. Nothing in inbox or spam. My email is correct on the account.

subject: Chargeback warning
body: I'll be disputing this charge with my bank unless you can explain why I was billed after I cancelled on the 3rd.
notes: Implicit refund request (threat of chargeback). Tests whether the model reads intent rather than keywords.

subject: Export to CSV missing columns
body: The CSV export is missing the 'owner' and 'created_at' columns that show in the UI. Minor but it breaks our weekly report script.

subject: Thanks!
body: Just wanted to say the support last week was great. Issue's resolved. You can close this.
notes: No real department fits. Whatever the model picks, the confidence should be low — that low confidence is the correct behaviour.

subject: Procurement paperwork
body: Our procurement team needs a W-9 and a signed security questionnaire before we can move to the enterprise tier. Who do I send these to?
